description: This Python module wraps and extends the functionality of the vendored 'appdirs' library within pip, providing platform-specific directory path functions for cache, config, and site configuration directories. It aims to standardize directory usage across different operating systems and gradually replace direct usage of 'appdirs'.

methods.name: str user_cache_dir(appname: str)
methods.description: Returns the user cache directory path for a given application name using the vendored 'appdirs' library.

methods.name: str _macos_user_config_dir(appname: str, roaming: bool = True)
methods.description: Determines the appropriate user config directory on macOS, preferring '~/Library/Application Support/pip' if it exists, otherwise defaulting to '~/.config' or similar.

methods.name: str user_config_dir(appname: str, roaming: bool = True)
methods.description: Returns the user config directory path based on the platform; calls platform-specific logic for macOS and delegating to 'appdirs' for others.

methods.name: List[str] site_config_dirs(appname: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of site-wide configuration directories, platform-specific, including '/etc' on Unix-y systems.

ctags.name: user_config_dir
ctags.pattern: /^def user_config_dir(appname: str, roaming: bool = True) -> str:$/
